capabilities: automatically append @start and @done dates to tasks
mark task priority with @priority markers from the editor menu or commands
filter tasks by date range, priority, and file path in a sidebar
archive completed tasks out of the source note into a SQLite database
save favorite file paths for quick filtering
extras: README links to Chinese-language documentation; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian tasks require manually typing start and completion dates, and completed tasks have no built-in way to be filtered across notes or stored after removal.
summary: Task timestamping plugin that auto-appends @start and @done markers, sets priorities, filters tasks across notes, and archives completed items.
